Sticky Scrollbar Page Fixture

This page makes fixed, sticky, and internal scrollbar regressions visually obvious.

Section One

The fixed header should appear once at the top of the stitched image.

Section Two

The sticky yellow nav should not repeat at every scroll step.

Section Three

The cyan cookie banner should not repeat near every tile boundary.

Section Four

The capture should still include content below multiple viewport heights.

Internal Scroll Panel

The red track and blue thumb are fixture markers. The capture pipeline should hide this scrollbar before viewport capture.
